$comment: The two gate sets (architecture.md sections 5.2 and 6). Each gate earned its keep in v1-v5; the table in architecture.md section 0.2 is the traceability record. Gates are scripts with exit codes, never vibes.

G-PLAN.mechanism: performed-timeline (from capture meta) diffed against the authored plan's actions; any drift fails

G-FASTSTART.mechanism: moov precedes mdat (atom walk or ffprobe trace)

G-SPEC.mechanism: ffprobe: h264 / yuv420p / 1920x1080 / fps / duration within 1 frame of plan
G-SPEC.container: silent AAC track explicit when audio deltas land; true -an until then

G-EYES.proves: a pair of agent eyes has SEEN the video
G-EYES.mechanism: verifier builds contact sheet + keyframe stills and READS them (image category); verdict text names what it saw
G-EYES.v1_origin: the vision-channel requirement (no shipped video without eyes)

G-GEO.proves: overlays and camera land where the plan says
G-GEO.mechanism: per-frame logged bboxes vs plan positions

G-POINTER.proves: the teaching pointer tracks REAL input, including inside zoom windows
G-POINTER.mechanism: pointer overlay coords vs harness per-frame input-coordinate log
G-POINTER.tolerance: <= 0.005 px (film profile; v2 measured max deviation 0.0044 px)

G-DETERM.mechanism: per-frame SHA-256 of every frame across two independent renders; NOT OpenFilm look's 12-frame sample

G-3LAUNCH.proves: capture is stable against warm-stack lies, font loads, ambient state
G-3LAUNCH.mechanism: three independent capture launches of the same plan produce identical frame sequences

G-GOLDEN.proves: no silent quality slide between iterations
G-GOLDEN.mechanism: three-tier dispatch per beat's `comparison` field (TIER E exact masked-region per-frame hash, zero tolerance; TIER P perceptual SSIM/pHash-dHash on representative frames with per-beat thresholds; TIER R lightweight representative key-frame references)
G-GOLDEN.storage: OQ3 approved (Option A): lab binaries + in-repo manifests (goldens/<beat-id>/)

perceptual.configurable: per-beat at mint (lands in golden provenance)

calibration.sigma_zero_policy: sigma == 0 => record sigma_zero:true and treat as exact-match at that metric
calibration.sample_set_approver: sample set approval rides reason_class 'calibration_update' (approved_by in {user, leader})
calibration.re_derivation_on_remint: thresholds re-derived on every re-mint; never carried over silently
calibration.seed_floor_clamp: derived thresholds may only be STRICTER than lane seeds (ssim_min >= 0.97, dhash_hamming_max <= 6); loosening requires an approval-worthy calibration_update event

boundary_detector._note: seed/starting value only; derived from the approved sample set's SSIM-drop/frame-diff distribution at mint (calibration supersedes)

semantic.exceedance_policy: FAIL unless explicit recorded waiver (approval record with reason)
